scope: Read-only comparison of reusable infrastructure with current ISA/common contracts; not RTL functional acceptance. New module packets not frozen at this review.

findings.issue: Separate read/write busy and owner ledgers allow different owners simultaneously on one bank.
findings.required: One exclusive owner role per logical bank, with atomic all-used-bank acceptance; reject aliases among used operands before grant.

findings.issue: Legacy compute matcher uses first-bank-derived tag/count/IDs without current transaction or captured generation identity.
findings.required: Match channel, transaction32, positional used mask/count/IDs and captured generations; hold identity through release acceptance. Unmatched completion sets07 and releases nothing.

findings.issue: Legacy contiguous count loop cannot represent QUANT/DQ positional mask101; obsolete opcode12 accepted and current13/14/15 absent.
findings.required: Decode all15 current opcodes;12 rejected. Bank0 is legal; unused operand is controlled by mask, never numeric bank ID.

findings.issue: Legacy untagged write completion validity lacks component generations, accepted-byte coverage and embedding selected-lane tracking.
findings.required: Separate coverage observation from engine completion; only accepted byte strobes update coverage. Success cannot manufacture readiness for gaps. Configuration atomically validates before target-only invalidation; errors invalidate target without rollback claims.

findings.issue: Producer begin changes live destination generation before completion echo of original accepted C generation.
findings.required: Maintain acquisition identity independently of live descriptor generation; producer begin/invalidate owner authorization uses accepted command plus active producer generation. Release compares original acquisition identity, not current live destination generation.

interface_separation: Dispatcher: command BRAM fetch/capture, exact raw128 record validation, strict-PC route, per-engine scoreboard, independent completion arbitration, terminal/fault drain and status.

Bank controller: exclusive atomic owner grant/release, captured descriptor snapshot, configuration/producer begin/invalidate handshakes, accepted-write coverage and embedding lane selector metadata. No tensor RAM, DMA engine or nonlinear arithmetic.

Generic external-engine channels may accept raw command/identity and return matched completion; this proves routing/control only. GEMM/QK/PV share one channel; QUANT/DQ share one channel. Do not imply external algorithm implementations.

Engine command acceptance and atomic bank acquisition must be the same architectural event. Avoid reserving banks while a downstream cmd_valid is stalled; explicitly define snapshot stability during stall and no circular ready dependency.
Define arbitration for simultaneous independent completions and configuration/producer/write events. Lossless ready/valid arbitration is valid; do not OR identities or drop a completion.
Preserve descriptors/content across START, END and FENCE. Coordinated reset is separate. END/FENCE wait both outstanding completion and accepted releases; no lookahead past blocked PC.

Generation is nonzero strictly monotonic per targeted component without wrap. B7 full targets1+2; window update preserves static coverage/gen, static update preserves window. Bank generation=max(component generations). Explicit BANK_CONFIG may skip generations.

Coverage storage is additional control capacity; byte masks must support duplicate, partial and gapped writes including GEMM N tiles and padded scales. A compact representation needs proof of identical readiness.
targeted_tests: All15 valid opcode routes with raw payload and positional roles; reserved12 and nonzero reserved bits reject before any acquisition.
QUANT dynamic and DQ mask101 with ignored bank1 alias; static QUANT mask111; bank0 legal; aliases among active operands rejected atomically.
One busy operand blocks entire request without partial owners; opposite read/write roles also conflict; disjoint DMA prefetch progresses concurrently with shared-GEMM work; no PC lookahead.
Stalled request payload/descriptor identity stability; exact once PC advance; downstream readiness and acquire grant agree; same-cycle completion/acquisition policy tested explicitly.

Matched completions reordered across channels, simultaneous completions, stalled release, repeated/duplicate/stale transaction/wrong channel/mask/ID/generation responses. Every mismatch07 leaves owners untouched; genuine outstanding still drains after sticky failure.

Failure concurrent with new request prevents new architectural issue; legal matched failure releases only after engine quiescence/invalidation. No DONE or terminal ERROR while tracked ownership remains outstanding.
Producer C old gen3 -> begin4 -> completion echoes3 -> matched release; subsequent producer begin5. Rejected begin/config leaves descriptor/coverage unchanged; generation0/stale/wrap rejected.

BANK_CONFIG all profiles shape/capacity boundaries, B7 component0/1/2 independence and generation max; embedding per-row selectors and selector-valid required; static-valid independent of RoPE window-valid.
Accepted-byte coverage partial BF16 masks, duplicate writes, gap writes, padding extent, late error invalidation, multi-N-tile GEMM accumulation, data complete with scale incomplete remains invalid.
END/FENCE/START across two fragments preserve metadata/content; missing END after16 records fails boundedly; active command metadata reset cancels only through coordinated reset policy.
claims_excluded: No new RTL simulation, lint or synthesis performed in this boundary review.
No functional claim for external DMA/nonlinear engines.
No physical tensor memory, routed integration, interface timing or board claim.
